--add-dir.description: Add a directory to the workspace (repeatable) (default [])

--agent.description: Agent for the current CLI session

--conversation.description: Resume a previous conversation by ID

--dangerously-skip-permissions.description: Auto-approve all tool permission requests without prompting

--disable-slash-commands.description: Disable slash command and skill expansion in print mode

--effort.description: Reasoning effort for the current CLI session (low|medium|high)

--input-format.description: Input format for print mode (text, stream-json). stream-json reads one NDJSON message per line from stdin and runs a turn for each; it requires --output-format stream-json (default text)

--json-schema.description: Optional JSON schema string or path to a schema file to enforce structured output (for stream-json, only applicable to the final result)

--mode.description: Set the agent execution mode for this session (accept-edits, plan)

--model.description: Model for the current CLI session

--new-project.description: Create a new project for this session

--output-format.description: Output format for print mode (text, json, stream-json) (default text)

--print.description: Run a single prompt non-interactively and print the response

--project.description: Project ID for the current CLI session

--prompt-interactive.description: Run an initial prompt interactively and continue the session

--sandbox.description: Run in a sandbox with terminal restrictions enabled
